title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #5

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is knowing your full name important for your safety? (1 mark)
   A. You can use it to tease others
   B. You can forget your family
   C. You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
   D. You can hide it from your parents

2. Why does no other person have the same fingerprints as you? (1 mark)
   A. Only twins have fingerprints
   B. Fingerprints are drawn at birth
   C. Every person is unique
   D. Fingerprints change every day

3. Why is it good to name your feeling, such as saying "I am angry"? (1 mark)
   A. It is a sin
   B. It makes the feeling bigger
   C. It helps you to decide what to do about it
   D. It makes others angry

4. What is joy, as a Christian understands it? (1 mark)
   A. A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us
   B. Having lots of money
   C. Never having problems
   D. Only laughing at jokes

5. Which action shows reverence for God? (1 mark)
   A. Throwing the Bible
   B. Laughing in church
   C. Talking during prayer
   D. Handling the Bible with care

6. Which is the last book of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Acts
   B. Malachi
   C. Jude
   D. Revelation

7. Which book comes directly after Genesis? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. Leviticus
   C. Exodus
   D. Numbers

8. What did Zacchaeus promise to give to the poor? (1 mark)
   A. One tenth
   B. All his possessions
   C. Half of his possessions
   D. Nothing

9. Why did the donkey turn away from the road? (1 mark)
   A. She was afraid of Balak
   B. She saw the angel and Balaam did not
   C. She was hungry
   D. She was tired

10. What did the donkey see on the road? (1 mark)
   A. A lion
   B. A wall
   C. A snake
   D. The angel of the Lord

11. What does the story of Samson mainly show? (1 mark)
   A. The power of lions
   B. The size of Timnah
   C. God's power
   D. The wealth of Philistines

12. What is a judge in the book of Judges? (1 mark)
   A. A priest
   B. A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   C. A court officer today
   D. A king

13. Why is Joseph a good example of leadership? (1 mark)
   A. He was rude
   B. He was selfish
   C. He was lazy
   D. He was honest, wise and hardworking

14. Which city did Abram come from? (1 mark)
   A. Nazareth
   B. Jericho
   C. Ur
   D. Jerusalem

15. What does the name Jesus mean? (1 mark)
   A. Great king
   B. Father of many
   C. The Lord saves
   D. Gift

16. What did Jesus say to the young man? (1 mark)
   A. Follow me
   B. Young man, I say to you, get up
   C. Go away
   D. Be quiet

17. What should we do when we face problems? (1 mark)
   A. Give up
   B. Blame others
   C. Hide
   D. Pray and ask for help

18. According to the Lord's Prayer, we ask God to forgive us as we: (1 mark)
   A. Forgive others
   B. Forget others
   C. Punish others
   D. Ignore others

19. What did Jesus pray on the cross? (1 mark)
   A. Father, forgive them
   B. Father, take me away
   C. Father, send angels
   D. Father, punish them

20. Is love only a feeling? (1 mark)
   A. No, it is also a choice and action
   B. Only for adults
   C. Only in church
   D. Yes

21. Which is a personal item? (1 mark)
   A. A school uniform
   B. The school gate
   C. A library book
   D. A classroom desk

22. Which is a way of keeping a uniform in good condition? (1 mark)
   A. Tearing it
   B. Leaving it in mud
   C. Washing and mending it
   D. Lending it out

23. Which of these is harmful to the body? (1 mark)
   A. Alcohol and drugs
   B. Sleep
   C. Vegetables
   D. Water

24. Who ran away from a wrong situation and was wise? (1 mark)
   A. Nicodemus
   B. Zacchaeus
   C. Balaam
   D. Joseph

25. Which of these is a way of serving God in church? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving litter
   B. Breaking chairs
   C. Talking during prayers
   D. Helping to clean

26. Which two disciples were brothers, sons of Zebedee? (1 mark)
   A. Matthew and Thaddaeus
   B. Thomas and Philip
   C. Peter and Andrew
   D. James and John

27. Which verse warns about bad company? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. 1 Corinthians 15:33
   D. John 3:16

28. Where is the Lord's Prayer found? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Matthew 6:9-13
   D. Acts 2:38

29. Which verse compares a person without self-control to a broken city wall? (1 mark)
   A. Proverbs 25:28
   B. John 3:16
   C. Proverbs 1:7
   D. Acts 2:38

30. What does "keep in step with the Spirit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Dance
   B. Run fast
   C. Walk in a line
   D. Follow the Spirit's guidance each day

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. List three school rules and give a reason for each. (3 marks)

32. Name two members of the extended family. (2 marks)

33. Explain the meaning of the word "inspired" when we say the Bible is inspired by God. (3 marks)

34. Explain why we should bless and not curse others. (3 marks)

35. Give three reasons why baptism is important to Christians. (3 marks)

36. Describe how Mary responded to the angel's message. (3 marks)

37. Explain three ways in which children can show God's love to others. (3 marks)

38. State three reasons why we should care for school property. (3 marks)

39. Explain four ways of building self-control. (4 marks)

40. What did Pharaoh's two dreams mean? (2 marks)

41. Give three examples of how a child can show self-control at school. (3 marks)

42. Explain how Luke 16:10 and Genesis 2:15 teach responsibility, and give examples from school and home. (5 marks)

43. Describe four ways in which a child can stand firm in their Christian faith. (4 marks)

44. Explain what a child should do if they are offered drugs or asked to do something that defiles the body. (5 marks)

45. State two ways of helping the kingdom of God to grow. (2 marks)

46. Name two things that Zacchaeus promised to do after meeting Jesus. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — You can tell a helper who you are if you get lost
   A name helps people identify you and help you find your family.

2. C — Every person is unique
   Fingerprints show that each person is one of a kind.

3. C — It helps you to decide what to do about it
   Naming feelings makes them easier to handle.

4. A — A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us
   Christian joy is based on God's love, not on our circumstances.

5. D — Handling the Bible with care
   Care with God's word shows respect.

6. D — Revelation
   Revelation is the last book of the New Testament and of the Bible.

7. C — Exodus
   The order is Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy.

8. C — Half of his possessions
   Zacchaeus said he would give half of his possessions.

9. B — She saw the angel and Balaam did not
   The donkey saw what Balaam could not see.

10. D — The angel of the Lord
   The angel stood in the road with a drawn sword.

11. C — God's power
   The Spirit of the Lord gave Samson strength.

12. B — A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   Judges were leaders who rescued Israel.

13. D — He was honest, wise and hardworking
   These qualities helped him to lead Egypt well.

14. C — Ur
   Abram was born in Ur of the Chaldeans.

15. C — The Lord saves
   Matthew 1:21 links His name to saving people from their sins.

16. B — Young man, I say to you, get up
   Luke 7:14 records this command.

17. D — Pray and ask for help
   We can bring our worries to God and to trusted adults.

18. A — Forgive others
   The prayer links our forgiveness with forgiving others.

19. A — Father, forgive them
   Luke 23:34 records this prayer.

20. A — No, it is also a choice and action
   Love is shown in actions.

21. A — A school uniform
   Personal items belong to you.

22. C — Washing and mending it
   Good care extends its life.

23. A — Alcohol and drugs
   Drugs and alcohol harm the body.

24. D — Joseph
   Joseph ran from temptation.

25. D — Helping to clean
   Cleaning is service.

26. D — James and John
   James and John were sons of Zebedee.

27. C — 1 Corinthians 15:33
   Bad company corrupts good character.

28. C — Matthew 6:9-13
   Matthew 6:9-13.

29. A — Proverbs 25:28
   Proverbs 25:28.

30. D — Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   Galatians 5:25.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Arrive on time, so lessons are not disturbed; keep quiet in class, so all can learn; do not fight, so all are safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with a reason.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Grandfather, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct member.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Inspired means that God guided the people who wrote the books. What they wrote is His message to people, so the Bible is God's word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God guiding the writers, 1 for the message being God's, 1 for the conclusion that the Bible is God's word.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words can build up or break down people. God wants us to love others. Blessing brings peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the power of words, 1 for God's wish for love, 1 for peace.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: It shows a decision to follow Jesus; it is a sign of being washed from sin; it joins us to the church; Jesus taught it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was troubled at first, asked how it could happen since she was a virgin, and then accepted, saying she was the Lord's servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for being troubled or asking, 1 for how, 1 for accepting.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Share, help the sick, forgive, speak kindly, include others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: It belongs to everyone; repair costs money; a clean school helps learning; others will use it later.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray each morning, set small goals, keep busy with good activities, choose good friends, avoid tempting situations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for plenty and 1 mark for famine.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for your turn, do not fight, do homework first, do not shout, do not copy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Luke 16:10 says being faithful in small things leads to bigger tasks. Genesis 2:15 says God gave people work to do and things to care for. At school a child covers books and cleans the class. At home a child washes plates and looks after younger siblings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse meaning, 1 for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for a clear link.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, say no to wrong, be proud to be a Christian, join a good church group, ask God for courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, walk away, avoid the group, tell a trusted adult such as a parent or teacher, pray for strength, and choose friends who make good choices.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying no, 1 for walking away, 1 for telling an adult, 1 for prayer, 1 for good friends.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Good example, prayer, inviting friends to church, sharing Bible stories.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Give half his possessions to the poor and pay back four times to anyone he cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each promise.
